entities.name: Simone Ballachi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Simone Ballachi was an Italian member of the Third Order of Saint Dominic. Ballachi served as a former soldier in Rimini before renouncing that path in favor of the religious life where he became a gardener noted for his strict adherence to the rule of Saint Dominic.
